title: Auto filters
intro: Queue junk tags automatically when your vault loads or refreshes. Keeps and favorites are never auto-tagged.
rulesBody: Matching pieces are queued as junk in Review (same as manual junk). Keeps are never auto-tagged: DIM keep/favorite, pending keep, or pieces you kept in a duel bucket.
operatorsIntro: Each filter can be <1>Is</1>, <2>Is not</2>, <3>Any of</3>, or <4>None of</4> (e.g. junk Hunter pieces whose archetype is none of Bulwark, Paragon).
livePreview_one: Live preview: {{count}} piece would be queued on next vault load (excluding keeps, favorites, and already junked).
